question: What process memory did the deterministic shipped-q3 transfer run use?
number: A deterministic duplicate of all 1280 arm runs matched every recorded result. Windows working-set sampler at 100 ms took 5291 samples and measured peak 26574848 B = 2^24.6635581042.
notes: Process working-set bound on deterministic duplicate only; not an organizer/package memory proof. No package/stage/filing/submission.
